What We Do

CDH is a part of your life if you’ve:

  • Eaten in a restaurant or purchased food at a store
  • Visited one of our clinics for a sick visit or wellness exam
  • Have children in child care
  • Applied for septic system or land use permits
  • Utilized WIC assistance
  • Attended a public festival or farmer’s market
  • Enrolled in a tobacco cessation program
  • Scheduled school vaccinations or sports physicals
  • Enjoyed a Fit and Fall Proof class
  • Participated in a school-based Sealant Clinic

We offer those services and many more.
